frontMatter.purpose:
As an employee of Mars Stitch Limited, you have the right to know about the prevailing labor laws and the company's own rules and regulations. Basically, the booklet has been published keeping this matter in mind. The book has been described in detail by coordinating the various sections and sub-sections of the labor law with the latest amendments to the law and the company's own rules and regulations. It describes the rights, responsibilities and duties of a worker towards the company, as well as the reasons for which he can be removed from employment, etc. By reading the book, not only will you benefit yourself, but the company will also be free from unnecessary harassment. I hope you will master the book well and try to apply it in the workplace.

chapters.title: Salary:
chapters.text:
Mars Stitch Ltd. is committed to maintaining a transparent remuneration system that allows employees to understand how their salaries, increments, and bonuses are determined.
01.The minimum monthly wage as re-determined by the Government of Bangladesh (announced on 20 December 2023) is 12,500 taka. We pay the minimum monthly wage of 12,500 taka.
02. The garment unit of the factory operates from 8.00 am to 5.00 pm, with a 1-hour lunch break at noon (12.45 pm to 1.45 pm and 1:15 pm to 2:15 pm).
03. The factory is closed on Friday as a weekly holiday.

chapters.title: Salary Increments & Performance Appraisal
chapters.text:
- Annual Increments: Salaries are reviewed annually based on individual performance evaluations.
- Performance-Based Promotions: Employees excelling in their roles are eligible for faster promotions to higher positions with increased compensation.
- Skills & Experience Bonus: Employees acquiring new skills, certifications, or completing training programs can qualify for additional pay increases.
## Absence without leave:
If a worker is absent without taking leave, he will be deducted from the basic wage as per the law for that number of days.

chapters.title: Bonus:
chapters.text:
* Every worker is given a bonus according to the company's policy in accordance with the laws of the country.
* Production bonus is given to production workers in the sweater factory according to the company's policy on production.
* Mars Stitch Ltd. offers a structured performance-based bonus scheme to reward employees for their contributions to the company's success. Bonuses are linked to key performance indicators such as company profitability, productivity targets, and departmental achievements. Eligible employees receive bonuses annually or quarterly, depending on the scheme. These include a profit-sharing bonus, production incentives, and team-based performance rewards. The bonus system is designed to motivate employees, enhance productivity, and align individual efforts with company growth while ensuring transparency in payouts

chapters.title: Family-Friendly Programs (FFPs)
chapters.text:
Mars Stitch Ltd. is committed to supporting employees in balancing their work and family lives by offering:
- Paid parental and care leaves for employees with family responsibilities.
- Childcare allowances or support for affordable and quality childcare services.
- Workplace protections such as maternity protection, job security during parental leave, and protection from unfair dismissal.
- These benefits are available to all employees, not just working parents, ensuring a family-friendly workplace.
## Medical:
* Workers working inside the factory appointed by the company are provided with free medical consultation and primary medical facilities throughout the year.
## Leave system
There are some specific procedures for getting leave in our factory. According to this system, all types of leave are given to workers.
Festive leave: 11 days of full pay are given in a year.
Casual Leave: A worker is given 10 days of casual leave with full pay in a year.
Sick Leave: A worker is given 14 days of sick leave with full pay in a year.
Annual/ Earned Leave: A worker gets this leave at the rate of 01 day for every 18 working days, this leave is available after one year of continuous work.
Maternity/Maternity Leave: A total of 16 weeks of maternity leave is provided. The condition is that only a pregnant woman is entitled to this benefit after 6 months of continuous work. A medical certificate is required in order to be pregnant.
Miscarriage Leave: 4 weeks for female employees.
## Leave Rules
*In order to get leave, any worker must complete the following formalities. Otherwise, the leave will not be admissible. If a worker is interested in taking leave, he must fill the prescribed leave application form.
*Leave is granted only after the leave application is approved by the Head of Department.
*In case of casual leave, it is necessary to get it passed before going on leave.
*After returning to work after sick leave, you must submit a leave application along with a medical certificate.

chapters.title: Flexible Work Arrangements
chapters.text:
Mars Stitch Ltd. recognizes the need for work-life balance and offers flexible work arrangements to employees, including:
- Remote Work: Employees may work from home under specific circumstances or based on job role suitability.
- Flexi-Time: Employees can choose staggered start and end times while ensuring core work hours are covered.
- Part-Time and Job Sharing: Available for employees who require reduced work schedules.
- Variable Work Schedules: Employees may adjust their schedules in agreement with management to accommodate personal responsibilities. These arrangements are designed to improve work-life balance while maintaining productivity and operational efficiency.
## Career Growth & Development
## nternal Career Mobility
Mars Stitch Ltd. actively promotes internal mobility to provide employees with career growth opportunities within the company. We encourage employees to develop their skills and transition into new roles through structured mobility programs. The company supports various forms of internal mobility, including:
- Vertical Mobility – Promotions and career advancements within the company based on performance, experience, and skills development.
- Horizontal Mobility – Opportunities for employees to move between different functions or departments while maintaining their job level, allowing them to diversify their skill set.
- Geographical Mobility – Transfer opportunities to different company locations, supporting business expansion and employee career aspirations.
- Transversal Mobility – Development of cross-functional skills by allowing employees to work in different departments on a temporary or permanent basis.
To facilitate internal mobility, Mars Stitch Ltd. provides:
- A transparent job posting system where employees can apply for open positions.
- Training and mentorship programs to prepare employees for new roles.
- Career counselling sessions to support employees in identifying growth opportunities within the company.
- A structured appraisal system that recognizes employees' potential for mobility.
## Fair Promotion & Professional Development Opportunities
Mars Stitch Ltd. is dedicated to ensuring equal access to career development and promotional opportunities for all employees. Our efforts to prevent discrimination in career growth and professional advancement include:
- Equal Access to Training Programs – Employees are encouraged to participate in skill-building and leadership training.
- Transparent Promotion Criteria – Promotions are based on performance evaluations, experience, and skillset, not personal characteristics such as gender, race, or background.
- Bias-Free Evaluation & Appraisal Process – Managers and HR teams receive training on eliminating biases from professional development assessments.
- Internal Job Postings – Open positions are shared with all employees, ensuring fair access to advancement opportunities.
- Mentorship & Career Growth Support – Employees are guided on professional development paths through mentorship programs.
## Women’s Development, Mentorship & Sponsorship Programs
To support women’s career advancement, Mars Stitch Ltd. has introduced dedicated mentorship and sponsorship programs for female employees. These initiatives include:
- Mentorship Matching: Senior leaders mentor women employees to guide their career growth.
- Women’s Leadership Training: Workshops and coaching sessions focused on leadership skills.
- Sponsorship Programs: High-potential female employees are connected with executive leaders for career sponsorship.
## Reasons for dismissal in employment:
In dismissing or laying off a worker, we follow the prevailing labor laws of the country. We dismiss a worker for the following misconduct.
## For example:
01. If a worker is convicted of a criminal offense.
02. According to section 23(4) of the Bangladesh Labor Act 2006 (amended), the following acts will be considered misconduct.
## Namely:
A. Willful disobedience, either alone or in concert with others, to obey any lawful or reasonable order of a superior authority.
B. Theft, embezzlement, fraud or dishonesty of the owner's business or property.
C. Accepting or giving bribes in connection with the employment of the owner or any other organization.
D. Habitual absence without leave or absence for more than ten days at a time without taking leave.
E. Habitual late attendance.
F. Habitual violation of any law, rule or regulation applicable to the establishment.
G. Disorder, riot, arson or vandalism in the establishment.
J. Habitual negligence in work.
I. Habitual violation of the service-related, discipline or code of conduct approved by the Chief Inspector.
J. Alteration, falsification, wrongful alteration, damage or loss of the official records of the owner.
## Workplace Safety & Health
## Workplace Safety Measures
- Regular fire safety drills and emergency evacuation plans.
- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) must be worn in hazardous areas.

chapters.title: Code of Conduct
chapters.text:
Employment Policy: Mars Stitch Limited considers the employment, salary, allowances, promotion, termination or dismissal of a person only on the basis of his/her qualifications and believes in this policy.
From the time of joining the job, Team Group employs every worker on a permanent basis after passing the minimum salary scale prescribed by the government and the entry qualification.
Recruitment Policy: In terms of recruitment of workers, new workers are recruited in all the factories of this group according to the recruitment policy that Mars Stitch Limited has.
Payment of wages: The workers and employees working at Mars Stitch Limited are paid the minimum wage prescribed by the new gazette (announced on December 20, 2023) determined by the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. Each employee receives a correct pay slip detailing their base salary, overtime (if any), and applicable bonuses. The company is committed to paying salaries within 07 working days of the following month. To ensure fair and transparent wage practices, Mars Stitch Ltd. actively promotes wage equality by conducting regular pay audits and salary structure reviews to identify and address any pay disparities. The company follows a structured, merit-based salary grid that ensures equal pay for equal work, irrespective of gender, age, ethnicity, or any other factor. All salary advancements and promotions are based on performance, experience, and skill level, ensuring that every employee has equal opportunities for growth and financial progression.
Discrimination: Mars Stitch Limited does not believe in any kind of discrimination in the workplace based on religion, caste, gender, marital status, political ideology, age, biological predisposition or any other such discrimination.
Child Labor: Mars Stitch Limited does not support the employment of any person below the age of 18 as a worker. For this reason, the worker is not employed without the age determination and capacity certificate of a registered doctor.
Working Hour & Overtime: Mars Stitch Limited agrees to the working hours prescribed by the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. If an employee works in excess of the prescribed working hours, he is paid all dues and overtime allowances as per the law. All types of overtime are paid in full as per the law.
Force Labour: Mars Stitch Limited does not believe in any kind of forced labour and does not employ workers without any kind of bail or liability.
Facilities: Mars Stitch Limited provides every worker and employee with facilities as per the laws prescribed by the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. They are: House rent (50% of basic salary), medical allowance, travel allowance, food allowance, attendance bonus, Eid bonus, health care.
Environment Health & Safety: Environment: Mars Stitch Limited has written policies regarding environment, health and safety and there is a safety and environment committee in the factory. Through which the necessary environment, safety and health laws are enforced.
Immigrant Law: Mars Stitch Limited employs those persons who have the legal right to work. For the sake of safety, the national identity card and necessary documents of the person employed are examined and verified before starting work.
Harassment: Mars Stitch Limited believes in the principle of showing respect and dignity to every worker and therefore, every factory has a zero-harassment policy. No worker shall be physically, sexually, mentally, or verbally humiliated or harassed in any form. To prevent workplace harassment, Mars Stitch Ltd. has implemented proactive measures, including:
- Regular awareness and sensitization sessions to educate employees about acceptable workplace behavior and harassment policies.
- Strict monitoring and enforcement mechanisms to prevent workplace harassment.
- Anonymous reporting channels and grievance mechanisms to ensure employees can safely report any harassment concerns without fear of retaliation.
- A dedicated internal committee to handle and investigate harassment complaints in a fair, transparent, and timely manner.
In case of an exception, legal written/disciplinary procedures are applied fairly to all workers, and any violations will result in strict action as per company policy and labor laws.
Employee Identification Document Policy: Mars Stitch Ltd. strictly prohibits the retention of employees’ personal identification documents, including National ID cards, passports, and other personal records. Employees are required to submit necessary identification only for verification purposes, and all documents are immediately returned. The company ensures that secure storage facilities are available for employees who wish to keep their documents safe while at work.
